findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_featured, submit_for_airplay, get_requests, get_recommendations, get_videos, get_genre · Private data: get_track, get_artist, submit_for_airplay, submit_sync_brief, pitch_for_playlist, rsvp, get_label, get_press_kit · Public sink: submit_for_airplay, submit_sync_brief, rsvp, get_genre · Destructive: verify_brief_candidates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_featured, submit_for_airplay, get_requests, get_recommendations, get_videos, get_genre · Private data: get_track, get_artist, submit_for_airplay, submit_sync_brief, pitch_for_playlist, rsvp, get_label, get_press_kit · Public sink: submit_for_airplay, submit_sync_brief, rsvp, get_genre · Destructive: verify_brief_candidates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
